title: Spec artifact's Dev Agent Record and Implementation notes still describe the pre-rework self-contained-CTE substitute, contradicting the shipped shared-insert implementation
evidence:
- N10/N11: substitution still uses the self-contained guarded CTE (atomic);
  the concurrent double-submit returns the existing successor (the 
  `how='existing'` path) — documented.
- **Substitution idempotency:** the SQL's CTE returns the EXISTING live
  successor (`how = 'existing'`) on conflict — a double-submit or
  re-substituting the old terminal row (kept as history) is a 200 no-op with
  no duplicate audit
detail: r2 N2's four drift points are fixed, but the artifact's own record sections now contradict its OWNS item 3 and the code: actions_handler.gleam:371 calls sql.insert_reference_call_if_absent (substitute_reference_call.sql no longer exists). The idempotency mechanism is misdocumented.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the N10/N11 record and Implementation-notes bullet to state substitution reuses insert_reference_call_if_absent (predicate in one place; Existing/AlreadyReplaced/SameReferee outcomes), or mark the record as historical.
